title: Rainfall Draining of Roof Areas and Vertical Downspouts
description: Capacities of vertical downspouts when draining roof areas in rainfall. Based on rainfall intensity of 100 mm per hour (4 inches per hour).

components.content:
## Notes

- The table is based on rainfall intensity of **100 mm per hour (4 inches per hour)**
- Rainfall intensity should always be checked with local authorities
- Gutters and downspouts are vulnerable to obstructions caused by branches and leaves from surrounding trees
- These factors should be considered when designing roof drainage systems
